description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions in the 'program helpers' module, using Vitest testing framework. It tests functions such as collectOption, parsePositiveIntOrUndefined, and resolveActionArgs, and references external modules like 'commander' and 'vitest'.

methods.name: collectOption
methods.description: Function that appends a value to an array, used to accumulate options in CLI commands.

methods.name: parsePositiveIntOrUndefined
methods.description: Parses a value and returns a positive integer or undefined if invalid.

methods.name: resolveActionArgs
methods.description: Extracts command-line arguments from a commander Command object.
